description: Main source file for clock synchronization sample on nRF hardware using Zephyr RTOS, implementing clock and timer management, clock status display, and synchronization logic.

methods.name: local_to_us
methods.description: Converts local timer ticks to microseconds based on sync configuration.

methods.name: ref_to_us
methods.description: Converts reference clock counts to microseconds based on sync configuration.

methods.name: us_to_text_r
methods.description: Formats a microsecond timestamp into a human-readable string with days, hours, minutes, seconds, and microseconds.

methods.name: us_to_text
methods.description: Returns a static buffer with formatted timestamp string.

methods.name: show_clocks
methods.description: Displays current status of LF and HF clocks.

methods.name: sync_work_handler
methods.description: Periodic handler to update synchronization state and display timing information.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point initializing clocks, timers, and starting synchronization process.
